title: ScriptGuide
description:
The generated sidecar module a custom script imports, and the stub the editor types against.

The runner writes `condor_data.py` into the scenes directory before every sequence, so the
module describes the scene table the graph is about to decode. The editor renders the same
module's stub, and one generator produces both strings: completion cannot describe a field
the module does not carry.

module_file.description: File name of the module inside the scenes directory, `condor_data.py`.

stub.description: Type stub for that module, as `condor_data.pyi`.

template.description: The starting script a new custom input begins from.

variables.description: The reserved VSScript variables the runner injects beside the module.

ScriptDataFormat.description: How a script variable's value is meant to be read once Python receives it.

ScriptDataKey.description:
One reserved variable the runner injects into a custom script, with its current value.

A large value is sent as a bounded preview so the state response stays small; `bytes`
still reports the full length and `truncated` says whether `value` is a prefix.

bytes.description: Full length of the injected string in bytes.

description.description: What the value contains, in the words the script editor shows.

format.description: How the value is read in Python.

key.description: The exact VSScript variable name, for example `condor_scenes`.

source.description: Where the runner derives the value, for example `condor.scenes`.

truncated.description: Whether `value` is a prefix of the injected string rather than the whole value.

value.description: The value as the engine injects it; bounded when `truncated` is true.
